model.name: R20.3: All item views default to COLLAPSED on render — always, every load.
model.description: Every item view (rb-object-item / tree item) in BOTH /trace AND in-room trees MUST default to COLLAPSED on render — meaning CHILDREN/subtree HIDDEN (expander ">" closed), NOT icon-only compact shrink. The item itself still shows its full card (icon + name + description) normally. Only the children are hidden. The user taps the expander to show children. This is a universal default on every load — no tree auto-expands. iOS SUB-POINT (skill-expert audit): oi-icon cursor:grab creates a dead click target on iOS Safari — tap-to-expand unreliable. Fix: icon tap must work on iOS (override cursor:grab on touch).
model.tronQuote:
> TRON: "make all itemviews by default collapsed… always."
> TRON (clarification): "collapsed means no children visible not icon only."

intendedChain.useCase: itemView.defaultCollapsed — on fresh render all items show full card but children/subtree HIDDEN (expander closed)
intendedChain.method: render / initCollapsed — children hidden by default, expander closed; NOT icon-only compact
intendedChain.implementation: constructor or connectedCallback sets this.collapsed=true; render reads it; no auto-expand
intendedChain.test: RED: (1) on fresh page load (/trace or room), all items show full card (icon+name+desc) but children subtree is hidden (expander closed). Currently FAILS (some auto-expanded). (2) on iOS Safari, tap expander on a collapsed item → children appear. Currently unreliable (cursor:grab suppresses tap).

model.crossRefNote: R19.27 (icon-tap collapses width to square) defined the collapse interaction. R20.3 sets the DEFAULT state to collapsed — items start collapsed and user expands, not the reverse.
